producer: Founder, transcribed by the agent from MiniMax customer service
subject: MiniMax 开放平台 CN account
obtained_by: Founder, from MiniMax customer service, with screenshot confirmation
read_this_first: This records what customer service TOLD the Founder about THIS account. Nothing here has been charged. No API call has yet been made under it. An account-level commercial assurance is not an API permission grant and is not a receipt.

live_measurement_supersedes_one_claim.what_was_done: The clone was created successfully with the pay-as-you-go API Key, exactly as this confirmation says it should be. The first synthesis with that voice -- the call that triggers the CNY 9.90 -- was then sent with the same pay-as-you-go key.
live_measurement_supersedes_one_claim.conclusion: The CNY 15.00 voucher was NOT taken up as the payment instrument for a pay-as-you-go API call. The platform required something this account does not have. Nothing was charged and no 欠费 was created.
live_measurement_supersedes_one_claim.why_this_is_recorded_rather_than_deleted: The confirmation was specific, plausible, screenshot-backed and still wrong about this one point. That is the generalisable finding: customer-service assurance settles commercial terms, not API behaviour. The other six claims above are untouched by this measurement and remain unproven as well as unrefuted.

claims.claim: 使用普通按量 API Key 可以创建克隆音色。
claims.meaning: The clone is created with an ordinary pay-as-you-go API Key, not with the Token Plan / M Plan Subscription Key.
claims.resolves_blocker: ROUTE_CLONE_KEY_REQUIRED / the 2061 refusal on the Subscription Key

claims.claim: 账户现有 ¥15 代金券可以优先用于本次消费。
claims.meaning: The existing CNY 15.00 voucher is the intended and prioritised payment instrument for this one-time consumption.

claims.claim: 克隆音色创建后，首次正式语音合成才触发 ¥9.9 克隆费。
claims.meaning: Creating the clone costs nothing. The one-time CNY 9.90 voice fee is charged at the FIRST real synthesis with that voice. Clone creation and first synthesis are therefore one billable session and must run back to back.
claims.resolves_blocker: none; it is the timing model the route already encoded

claims.claim: 支付首次费用后，音色可永久保留。
claims.meaning: After the first charge the voice becomes permanently valid rather than temporary, which is the exception to the documented 168-hour temporary-voice TTL.
claims.resolves_blocker: the CLONE_TTL_SECONDS expiry, for a voice that HAS been activated

claims.claim: 后续使用不会重复收取克隆费。
claims.meaning: The one-time fee is charged once. Later uses of the same voice pay only the normal per-character amount.
claims.resolves_blocker: none; it bounds the maximum total spend

claims.claim: 已激活音色可以用于现有 M Plan 套餐的语音合成。
claims.meaning: A voice that has already paid the CNY 9.90 may be used for speech synthesis under the existing M Plan Subscription Key.
claims.resolves_blocker: nothing on its own. This is a COMMERCIAL statement. Whether the API permits it is an API-level permission question answered only by one real synthesis; error 2042 (无权访问该 voice_id) is the documented symptom if it does not.

claims.claim: 代金券只可用于消费，不可用于抵扣欠费金额。
claims.meaning: A voucher may only pay for consumption; it cannot offset an owed amount. Confirms the ceiling is a consumption ceiling and says nothing about priority against cash.
claims.resolves_blocker: none; it is a constraint, recorded so it is not mistaken for a permission

second_live_measurement.authorisation: Founder, separately and explicitly authorised. This is NOT a retry of the pay-as-you-go request: same voice, same model, same text, different credential class, its own one-request budget (1 synthesis, 0 uploads, 0 clones).
second_live_measurement.what_was_done: One speech-2.8-hd synthesis with founder_primary_v1, sent through the project's official MiniMaxMPlanProvider with the M Plan Subscription Key bound into the transport. No upload, no /v1/voice_clone, no pay-as-you-go key reachable from the path, no retry.
second_live_measurement.conclusion: The refusal does not depend on the credential. Two credential classes, one identical answer, zero charge. The blocker is the PAYMENT INSTRUMENT, not key routing: the Subscription Key's published deduction chain (套餐内额度 -> 积分包) does not reach the 快速复刻 activation fee, and the voucher is not accepted as payable balance for it either.
second_live_measurement.why_this_is_recorded_rather_than_reporte: A single refusal is ambiguous -- it could be the key, the plan, the model, or the fee. Two refusals under two different credentials with an identical message remove every one of those readings except the fee. That is the whole value of the second experiment, and it is why no further trial on this account is worth running.

third_live_measurement.what_changed: The Founder accepted the exposed-key risk in full and authorised one cash-paid activation. cash_balance had since been raised from 0.00 to 10.00. A new single-use, scope-limited exception FOUNDER_AUTHORISED_EXPOSED_KEY_REUSE permitted exactly one request.
third_live_measurement.what_was_sent: One speech-2.8-hd synthesis with founder_primary_v1 through the official CLI with the pay-as-you-go key bound in. No upload, no /v1/voice_clone, no retry.
third_live_measurement.conclusion: THE CRITICAL FINDING. With CNY 10.00 of CASH available -- more than the CNY 9.90 fee -- the platform still answered 'insufficient balance'. The refusal is therefore NOT about the account's spendable balance, and not about the credential class. Three refusals, three different balance/credential combinations, one identical message: the CNY 9.90 clone-activation fee cannot be paid through this API on this account at all. It is not a funds problem and not a key-routing problem.
what_this_rules_out: M Plan plan quota as the instrument (round 2) -- refuted
cash balance as the instrument (round 3) -- refuted, with 10.00 available against a 9.90 fee
credential class as the cause -- refuted, identical message under both PAYG and Subscription
third_live_measurement.what_this_does_not_establish: It does not say WHY the fee is unpayable. The documented rule is that the fee is charged at first synthesis, so either that path is closed on this account, or the fee is settled through a console-side purchase rather than an API debit. No reachable source distinguishes these, and none is guessed here.
third_live_measurement.nothing_charged: CNY 0.00 across all three attempts. No recharge, no Credit Pack, no 欠费.

still_unverified: that the rotated PAYG API Key is accepted by the host for a clone -- ANSWERED: a read-only get_voice probe accepted it and returned this account's own cloned voice
the actual amounts charged -- ANSWERED: none. Both attempts charged CNY 0.00 and every balance was unchanged
whether a Subscription Key can pay the clone activation fee -- ANSWERED: no, measured, identical refusal to the pay-as-you-go attempt
whether deduction priority between voucher and cash within 账户余额 is voucher-first -- still unknown and now MOOT for this fee, since the voucher was never taken up for it at all
that no recharge, no Credit Pack use and no 欠费 can occur -- CONFIRMED by measurement across both attempts: cash 0.00, credit 0.00, owed 0.00 before and after both

founder_authorisation.stop_condition: 如果无法限制支付来源为代金券、存在自动扣现金或形成欠费的风险,在发送真人录音之前停止。
founder_authorisation.hard_ceiling_rule: 如实际计费金额高于 ¥10,禁止继续生成。
